description: Trigger accuracy evaluation for the z-image skill. Each entry is a user prompt that should or should not trigger this skill.

should_trigger.query: Write me a Z-Image Turbo prompt for a photorealistic portrait of an older woman in a bakery.
should_trigger.why: Canonical prompt-writing request for the model this skill covers.

should_trigger.query: Why does my negative prompt do nothing in Z-Image Turbo?
should_trigger.why: Turbo has no CFG so the negative channel is inert - the skill's headline fact.

should_trigger.query: Z-Image gives me almost the same picture on every seed. How do I get variety?
should_trigger.why: Turbo is rated Low diversity; skill documents prompt-varying tactics and the switch to base.

should_trigger.query: What steps and guidance should I use for Tongyi Z-Image?
How do I get Z-Image to render a headline correctly on a poster?
should_trigger.why: Bilingual text rendering with quoted strings - documented capability.

should_trigger.query: My local image model output looks plastic and airbrushed, running mflux-generate-z-image-turbo.
should_trigger.why: Names the runner command and the classic missing-texture failure mode.

should_trigger.query: Should I use Z-Image or Z-Image-Turbo for a batch of illustration variants?
should_trigger.why: Variant selection question, the core fork in this skill.

should_trigger.query: Can I use Z-Image-Edit to change an object in my photo?
should_trigger.why: Skill must state that Edit was still unreleased on the official Model Zoo.

should_not_trigger.query: Generate a video from this image.
Write me a Nano Banana prompt for a YouTube thumbnail.
should_not_trigger.why: Different vendor and model - nano-banana skill.

should_not_trigger.query: How do I install CUDA drivers on Ubuntu?
Recommend a stock photo site for commercial use.
Explain how diffusion models work mathematically.
should_not_trigger.why: Theory question, not prompt craft for this model.
